gate_rule: consume one payload rank iff filtered next-token Shannon entropy in bits is greater than or equal to the model-specific threshold

ineligible_token_policy.allowed_token_mask: same mask as the paired RankCloak condition

thresholds.moderate: model-specific median from ordinary-generation development traces
thresholds.strict: model-specific 75th percentile from ordinary-generation development traces

calibration.threshold_pooling: pool all six clean development traces within model

paired_seed_policy.rankcloak: one stable seed per experimental cell, shared by ungated, moderate, and strict conditions
paired_seed_policy.ordinary_control: one separately derived stable seed per experimental cell, shared by all gate levels
paired_seed_policy.length_matched_prefix_rule: controls at different target lengths are deterministic prefixes of one ordinary trace

generation_blocker_policy: do not acquire large weights, credentials, or paid compute automatically
